definitions.explanation: A formal telegram sent to offer congratulations, typically for weddings, promotions, or other celebrations. Still used in Japan for ceremonial occasions even in the digital age.

examples.japanese: {祝電|しゅくでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{祝電|しゅくでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: A congratulatory telegram arrived for the wedding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}できない→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{祝電|しゅくでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Instead of attending, I decided to send a congratulatory telegram.

notes:
Composed of {祝|しゅく} (celebration) + {電|でん} (telegram). Although telegrams have largely disappeared from daily life, {祝電|しゅくでん} remain a living tradition in Japan, especially at weddings and school ceremonies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祝電|しゅくでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send a congratulatory telegram
- {祝電|しゅくでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to send a telegram (lit. "strike")
- {祝電|しゅくでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: a congratulatory telegram arrives
- {祝電|しゅくでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる→読み上げる：04604_yomiageru⟧: to read aloud a congratulatory telegram

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弔電|ちょうでん}→弔電：22863_chouden⟧: condolence telegram — sent for funerals, the opposite occasion
- ⟦{電報|でんぽう}→電報：01474_denpou⟧: telegram — the general word for any telegram
- ⟦{祝辞|しゅくじ}→祝辞：14759_shukuji⟧: congratulatory speech — spoken rather than written
